youtube_description:
A 1998 live-action direct-to-video film directed by Stephen Furst based on the Harvey Entertainment Company animated character, Baby Huey. It was originally released by Columbia Tristar Home Video on VHS in 1999 and later to DVD in 2005 by Classic Media.

Uniquely for a direct-to-video motion picture, it features a primarily all-star cast, and it also serves as the latest production to feature the character, Baby Huey.
